_readme: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and edit. Never commit real keys: put them in env vars and reference them with api_key_env. Chain order: agents.primary -> agents.fallback -> agents.local (optional).

providers._comment: PRIMARY: Google Gemini from TrueForge's catalog (no name/base_url: the provider is named after its type). Set GEMINI_API_KEY in your shell. Free tier is ~15 requests/minute; the extension waits out 429s automatically.

FALLBACK: OpenRouter through TrueForge's 'custom' OpenAI-compatible provider. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY (https://openrouter.ai/keys). model_id can be any OpenRouter model that supports tool calling; free ':free' models are retired often (qwen/qwen3-coder:free already was; its paid slug qwen/qwen3-coder still works), so check https://openrouter.ai/models?supported_parameters=tools and edit model_id if this one is gone.
providers.name: openrouter

providers._comment: OPTIONAL LAST RESORT: a local model behind Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (no key needed; a placeholder is used). Start Ollama with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384. Remove this provider and agents.local if you do not use Ollama.
providers.name: local-llm
